integrity: The accompanying result supplies a complete analytic proof; finite checker outputs corroborate but do not replace an infinite argument. No independence or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The theorem counts only antipodal primitive two-cycles of the displayed real-plane recurrence, not all two-cycles.
The asymptotic is for fixed positive coupling b and unbounded gain a, not bounded-gain attractor statistics.
Asymptotic repulsion does not establish mixing, chaotic attractors or cryptographic security.
Original article Table 1 is embedded as a graphical table; the recurrence and current charge-accumulation convention are explicit here.
Independent priority check and independent mathematical audit have not been performed.
title: Cubic proliferation and asymptotically universal repulsion of antipodal two-cycles in a quadratic memristor sine map
